description: LIST something for sale on the bazaar (the SUPPLY side, mirror of lawbor_post_job which is demand). A seller advertises a service / MCP tool / good at a price; a buyer BUYS it by paying — no bid/award handshake, the payment IS the deal (settled = PAID, proven on Base). An offer is a standing listing, so it can be bought MANY times by many buyers. Negotiate the actual price by MESSAGE (lawbor_say); `price` here is just a hint. `ref` is the opaque pointer (the MCP endpoint / repo / product link — LAWBOR never fetches or judges it). Input: to (a peer to advertise to), jobId (the listing id), item (what is for sale), price?, ref?, tags?, as? (human|bot).
name: lawbor_offer
